Class SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest

java.lang.Object
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.Message
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.request.control.SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest
public class SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest extends Message
The pump applies only the fields named in changedFields. Every other field must still carry the pump's current value, as the Tandem app does: build a change with forChange(com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.PumpGlobalsResponse, boolean, com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.request.control.SetQuickBolusSettingsRequest.QuickBolusMode, int).
